"An independent CarPlay receiver for Android head units. Wired and wireless connections run on the head unit, with local authentication. A standard iPhone can connect without a jailbreak, Mac, dongle or sign-in.
This preview uses an experimental accessory identity. Compatibility with every iPhone and head unit is still being tested. It is not an Apple-certified product."

Quick; may stutter now and then on wireless.
Steadiest; sound is about 1 s late (you notice it on pause and skip).
Default: quick and steady on most head units.
Very quick; for a cable or a strong wireless signal.
For unsteady Wi‑Fi; sound is half a second late.
The smallest buffer the device allows: sound starts fastest, but weak Wi‑Fi makes it stutter.

Automatic (recommended): music on the media volume, prompts on the navigation/prompt volume, chosen by sound type.
System volume (STREAM_SYSTEM): on some head units the only one that reaches the car amplifier.
Media volume (STREAM_MUSIC): the music volume on most head units.
Alarm volume (STREAM_ALARM): not muted with the media volume; some units use it for prompts.
Bluetooth call volume (STREAM_BLUETOOTH_SCO): on many units it only sounds during a call.
Enforced system sound (STREAM_SYSTEM_ENFORCED): often not changed by the volume keys.
Speech (STREAM_TTS): some head units give spoken prompts their own volume.

"06Link %1$s is based on the open-source DiPlay 0.2.8 project (GPL-3.0). Receiver based on xcertplay, licensed under GPL-3.0. DiPlay’s interface follows DiAuto’s design, licensed under AGPL-3.0.
Includes AndroidX, Kotlin, Bouncy Castle, JmDNS, SLF4J, Concentus (Opus, BSD license), ZXing (QR codes, Apache-2.0), the OpenJDK library backport (GPL-2.0 with Classpath Exception) and FFmpeg 7.1.5 (LGPL-2.1 or later; source at ffmpeg.org). Source and license notices accompany this release.
CarPlay and the CarPlay icon belong to Apple Inc. 06Link is an independent project."
